pages.title: Stitch in a Halloween Skeleton Costume Coloring Page
pages.description: Stitch wears a skeleton jumpsuit in this printable coloring page, raising his clawed paws beside a jack-o-lantern, with a full moon above. The coloring sheet separates the rib cage, arm bones, and leg bones into outlined shapes, while a zipper runs down the center of the costume.

pages.title: Stitch in a Devil Costume with a Pitchfork Coloring Page
pages.description: Stitch holds a pitchfork in this printable coloring page, wearing devil horns and a cape beside a jack-o-lantern beneath a moon and bat. His pointed costume tail curves behind him, and one clawed paw reaches forward. The coloring sheet leaves open areas across his face, cape, pumpkin, and three-pronged pitchfork.

pages.title: Stitch in a Werewolf Costume by the Moon Coloring Page
pages.description: Stitch wears a furry werewolf costume in this printable coloring page, with a wolf hood, raised clawed paws, and a full moon behind him. The wolf hood has pointed ears and fangs, while a bow ties beneath Stitch's chin. Jagged fur outlines and the moon's round markings add smaller sections to the broad shapes in this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Stitch Ringing a Doorbell on Halloween Coloring Page
pages.description: Stitch rings a doorbell in this printable coloring page, wearing a vampire cape and carrying a pumpkin candy bucket beside a porch lantern. One paw presses the button while the other grips the bucket handle. The coloring sheet includes pointed fangs, a bow tie, wooden siding, and a door frame around the standing character.

pages.title: Stitch Trying on a Halloween Monster Mask Coloring Page
pages.description: Stitch tries on a monster mask in this printable coloring page, watching his reflection in an oval mirror beside a pumpkin-shaped trick-or-treat bucket. The mask has curved horns, three round eyes, and a row of pointed teeth. The coloring sheet shows Stitch from behind, with the reflection revealing his face and raised paws.
